> What does a plant need to survive ?

- Plants need food as well as our bodies to grow and survive.

- We must provide the plant with all its needs to able to grow.

Example : When a tree is planted, it begins to grow from a seedling into a mature
tree depending on some resources such as water, air and sunlight to
make its food to survive.
